summary: Re-grill of the project sign-off for symphony-forge itself. The prior record (2026-07-24) went stale only because the decision corpus grew from 10 records to 18; the sign-off substance was not in question. Reconciled against all 18 current records, the three confirmed specs, and the spec-linked roadmap.
gaps: The sign-off gate became DERIVED rather than recorded (91ec45a): harness.yaml pins a decision record and every gate resolves the answer from it. 0010-client-signoff — this project's actual sign-off evidence, confirmed_by vrknetha on 2026-07-24 — had been marked superseded by 0014, so nothing satisfied the pin and the harness repo failed its own gate, on main as well as locally.
docs/specs/repo-system-of-record.md sat in draft while the capability it describes was live, and 0014 requires that no spec remain in draft before sign-off can be recorded.
contradictions: 0014 declared itself to supersede 0010 while its own Decision section states 'From 0010, retained unchanged: the harness maintainer is the client for symphony-forge itself.' A record cannot both retire another and retain it unchanged; the supersession retired the only evidence this project was ever signed off.
resolutions: 0010 restored to accepted and the relationship corrected in both records: 0014 EXTENDS the preconditions for RECORDING sign-off (confirmed specs, a derived roadmap) rather than retiring the sign-off artifact. Frontmatter now reads extends/extended_by. Done on maintainer confirmation in chat, 2026-08-04.

docs/specs/repo-system-of-record.md grilled and confirmed against the shipped system, and linked to FORGE-LOCK-1, whose planning-lock scope the spec names directly ('lock alignment' under 0017). Spec debt cleared.
open_items: Non-blocking: 0017-repo-as-system-of-record and 0018-delegation-gates are `proposed` while the capabilities they govern are live. Acceptance is human chat confirmation and is not part of this gate; both are surfaced to the maintainer.
Non-blocking: 0004-mandatory-plan-mode is superseded by 0013 and correctly inactive.

Non-blocking: the harness repo is its own client (0010). Stakeholder, constraint and non-functional questions that a client project's sign-off would hunt are answered by that decision rather than re-elicited.
